heading: Reflections & perspectives
intro: Thoughtful, psychologically informed writing from my psychological counselling practice on emotional wellbeing, relationships, stress, mindfulness, and navigating change — calm, reflective, and accessible.
authorBody: Theresa Frische is a Systemic & Integrative Counsellor working online with internationals, expats, and couples navigating change. Sessions are offered in English and German.
metaDescription: Thoughtful, psychologically informed writing on emotional wellbeing, relationships, stress, mindfulness, and navigating change.
